title: Dark mode: decision record
text:
Status: Decided. Owner: Priya. Date: 2024-11-02.

Decision: we will not build a dark mode theme for the web dashboard in this cycle. The request has come up several times and is explicitly ruled out for now. Revisit only after the design-system token refactor lands, because every color is currently hard-coded in component styles and a second theme would double the surface we hand-maintain.

Context: three separate feature requests asked for a dark theme between June and October. Support volume does not justify the cost yet, and the accessibility contrast work that would have to ship alongside it is not scoped.

Alternatives considered: a community-maintained user stylesheet was rejected because it breaks on every release; an OS-preference auto-switch was deferred to the same revisit.
